display.purpose: Page titles: a short noun with a full stop.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, card titles; the only uppercase.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Hover ticket and dialogs, with backdrop blur.

motion.name: theme-glide
motion.purpose: Colours glide while the gradient morphs on theme switch.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Content rises once after the sign-in intro; a fade under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in an area.

components.name: Field
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;font-family:'Roboto Mono',ui-monospace,monospace}.ds-field span{font:500 11px/1.4 inherit;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#4c4f48}.ds-field input{border:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(11,12,10,.12);background:transparent;padding:8px 0;font:400 15px/1.4 inherit;outline:none}.ds-field input:focus{border-color:#0b0c0a;box-shadow:0 1px 0 #0b0c0a}.ds-field em{font:400 12px/1.45 inherit;font-style:normal;color:#4c4f48}

components.name: Keycap
components.description: An event, booth or station as a tile.
components.css: .ds-key{display:grid;gap:6px;width:150px;min-height:104px;padding:14px;border-radius:12px;background:#c6f36b;color:#0b0f05;box-shadow:inset 0 -4px 0 #9fcc45;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Roboto Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;transition:transform .14s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow .12s ease}.ds-key span{font:500 11px/1.4 inherit;letter-spacing:.05em}.ds-key b{font:500 20px/1 inherit}.ds-key i{font:400 12px/1.2 inherit;font-style:normal;opacity:.8}.ds-key:hover,.ds-key:focus-visible{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 #9fcc45,0 0 0 2px rgba(11,12,10,.75);outline:none}

components.name: Navigation
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:16px;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(250,248,242,.42);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.75),0 18px 40px -22px rgba(0,0,0,.45);font:500 13px/1 'Roboto Mono',ui-monospace,monospace}.ds-nav a{color:#4c4f48;text-decoration:none;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px solid transparent}.ds-nav a[aria-current=page]{color:#0b0c0a;border-color:#0b0c0a}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgba(11,12,10,.75);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: pbooth is run by one owner and a few staff, often at a venue on a phone or a laptop beside a booth. The admin is a working tool: quiet editorial type, a slow lime-and-periwinkle shader gradient behind everything, and content on light glass sheets. Colour is spent almost entirely on state: lime means live or primary, periwinkle means scheduled, ash means idle or done. Everything else is ink on paper (or paper on night).
keyCharacteristics: One large serif statement per page, ending in a full stop ("Stations."), over small mono labels.
One glass sheet per section; nothing nested in a second box.
Lime is rare: the primary button, live keys, the live dot.
Status is a coloured dot and a word, never a filled badge.
Light and dark both designed; dark mode is chosen by the viewer, not by category.

rules.name: The Lime Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Lime marks what's live or the one main action in an area. If two lime buttons sit side by side, one of them is secondary.

rules.name: The Dot And Word Rule
rules.body: State reads as a 7px dot plus a plain word. Colour alone never carries meaning.

rules.name: The Serif For Titles Only Rule
rules.body: The serif never sets a sentence of UI copy or a button.

rules.name: The One Box Rule
rules.body: A section is one glass sheet; panels inside it have no second frame.

dos: **Do** set every dynamic value (colours, aspect ratios, crops) through a CSS variable from a ref; the page's security policy refuses inline `style`.
**Do** keep burnt red at 4.5:1 or better wherever it's text.
**Do** keep reduced motion meaningful: no travel or scaling, but fades, colour changes and progress fills stay.
**Do** use native `<dialog>` with `showModal()` for anything that interrupts.
donts: **Don't** add a second accent colour, or use lime for decoration.
**Don't** nest a card inside a glass sheet.
**Don't** add uppercase beyond labels and row buttons.
**Don't** crop guests' photos in a gallery; show each one whole.
**Don't** animate on a failure (a wrong password gets no flourish).
